message.tacz.pack_compatibility.help:
Conversion guide:
Process local packs in a singleplayer world with cheats enabled; contact the server administrator about server packs.
1. Run %s to check the packs.
2. Run %s to export converted packs.
3. After conversion, follow the instructions to replace the original packs with the new content packs generated in tacz-converted/, then restart the game.
